item.title: Eng Bee Tin x BPI VYBE Chinese New Year Promo: Free Hopia or Tikoy Rolls
item.description: Eng Bee Tin is making your Chinese New Year sweeter! Spend at least ₱400 via QR Ph with BPI VYBE at participating Eng Bee Tin branches to enjoy FREE Premium Hopia or Tikoy Rolls - a festive treat for every foodie!

item.title: Krispy Kreme CNY Promo: Free Lucky Charm Doughnuts
item.description: Welcome the Lunar New Year the Krispy Kreme way! ✨Krispy Kreme is welcoming the Chinese New Year with a delicious treat! item.title: Celebrate Chinese New Year 2026: 2 Pearl Milk Teas for ₱26 with BPI & Chatime!
item.description: Celebrate Chinese New Year 2026 with a sweet surprise from BPI and Chatime! 🐴🏮Ring in the Year of the Horse with a bigger and better treat—get 2 Regular Pearl Milk Teas for only ₱26 when you pay via QR using your BPI app at any Chatime store nationwide.
